title: Preserve mailbox provenance across sender deletion during dispatch
outcome: If the sender session disappears between durable append and dispatch source resolution, the live-session lookup drops structured mailbox provenance. The wake can dispatch as ordinary text and later be recreated. Preserve backend-owned mailbox metadata independently of live sender lookup while retaining a safe sender snapshot.
acceptance: Deleting or losing the sender before wake dispatch cannot strip mailbox metadata, duplicate the wake, or expose the body; a deterministic regression test covers the race.
